title: Automatic regression triage: an evidence ladder, not a generated explanation
description: Roadmap rule 1 (evidence before narration): every conclusion here must be traceable to `steps[]`. `summary` is a recomputable rollup of `steps`, never an independent claim -- a reader who distrusts `summary` can always re-derive it. `root_cause` must never appear as a status anywhere in this document; `summary.classification` may name a cause only when exactly one step reached `causally_supported`, and is `undetermined` otherwise.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this artifact was assembled.

source_experiment_id.description: Present only when the baseline/candidate runs were resolved from a clozn.experiment.result.v0 artifact (feature 04's schema, consumed by name here, not defined here).

case_id.description: Present only alongside source_experiment_id: the experiment case name that was triaged.

kind.description: Free-text step identifier, e.g. 'identity_diff:model', 'template_swap'. Not an enum: the triage order (roadmap spec) is open-ended and later slices add kinds without a schema edit.

inputs.description: What this step was given (run ids, budgets, swap targets). Omitted keys mean unavailable, never null-padded.

observations.description: The raw facts this step measured. Never prose-only -- each item should be reconstructible evidence (a path, a value, a hash), not a claim.

caveats.description: Standing limitations of this specific step's measurement (e.g. a fingerprint that conflates two identity dimensions). Must survive into summary.caveats, not just live here.

reason.description: Required in practice (not schema-enforced, since only not_run/unsupported/inconclusive steps need one) whenever status is not_run, unsupported, or inconclusive: why.

classification.description: 'undetermined' unless exactly one step reached causally_supported, in which case this is that step's own `kind` verbatim -- never a hand-authored label.

eliminated.description: Step kinds whose comparison matched -- hypotheses ruled out.

observed.description: Step kinds whose comparison mismatched but were never isolated by a controlled intervention -- live candidate causes, not proven ones.
